name: Nak's Skull
summary: In the southern Barrens, Nak leads Razormane warbands against the Horde. His skull proves his defeat and gives Mangletooth a means to avenge betrayal by his former kin.

sections.title: A Token of Vengeance
sections.body: Nak, Kuz, and Lok Orcbane lead raids from Razorfen Kraul across the Barrens. Their warbands strike Horde settlements and roads, while defenders at the Crossroads do not know the three commanders are planning attacks beyond ordinary tribal skirmishing. At Camp Taurajo, the captive Razormane Mangletooth has been left to die in a cage by his own people. He now seeks revenge against those former brethren. Mangletooth demands proof that Nak and his companions are dead: their severed skulls, delivered by Horde adventurers. He means to use that proof to break the southern raiding parties.

faq.answer: Nak is a Razormane quilboar commander who leads raids with Kuz and Lok Orcbane. The three emerged from Razorfen Kraul and strike Horde travelers and settlements across the southern Barrens.

aliases: who do i give naks skull to
faq.answer: Mangletooth, a captive Razormane quilboar at Camp Taurajo, wants Nak's Skull. His own kin abandoned him, and he seeks revenge on the leaders who betrayed him.

faq.q: Why does Mangletooth want the skulls of his own people?
faq.answer: Nak, Kuz, and Lok Orcbane abandoned Mangletooth to die in captivity. He retaliates by helping the Horde find them and demanding their severed heads as proof they are dead.

faq.q: Does collecting Nak's Skull help protect the Crossroads?
faq.answer: Yes. Mangletooth says Nak and his partners direct Razormane raids against the Crossroads and the central trade routes. Their defeat weakens the tribe's coordinated attacks.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you can ease pressure on supply lines between Camp Taurajo and the Crossroads by taking the heads of Razormane warlords like Nak.
